rows.text: Statement of the Bank Board for the press conference following the monetary policy meeting
At its meeting today, the Bank Board of the Czech National Bank increased the two-week repo rate by 25 basis points to 0.50%.
At the same time, it increased the Lombard rate to 1.25% and kept the discount rate unchanged at 0.05%.
